summary: SECURITY AUDIT COMPLETE - Comprehensive security and code quality review of entire project. No critical secrets found in source code. Auth bypass protection working correctly. Several MEDIUM/LOW priority issues identified including hardcoded URLs, restaurant-specific data, and CORS configuration.

medium.recommendation: Consider restricting CORS origins to specific domains in production

medium.issue: Error responses expose Pydantic validation details including input data
medium.recommendation: Sanitize error messages to not expose input validation structure

low.issue: Default restaurant_name 'Hotel Lumiere' hardcoded in BrandingConfig model
Google Fonts URL hardcoded in BrandingConfig
low.recommendation: Font URLs are typically safe to hardcode

security_issues.issue: User token stored in localStorage (accessible to JavaScript)
security_issues.details: Token is stored in localStorage via kiosk_user. While common practice, HttpOnly cookies are more secure.
security_issues.recommendation: For kiosk apps, localStorage is acceptable. For production web apps, consider HttpOnly cookies.

security_issues.issue: Password stored in sessionStorage (temporary session only)
security_issues.details: Password stored in sessionStorage for session persistence. Cleared on browser close. Previous localStorage password storage properly cleaned up.
security_issues.recommendation: ACCEPTABLE for kiosk auto-login. Password removed on browser close.

hardcoded_urls.issue: Hyatt logo URL hardcoded in multiple components
hardcoded_urls.recommendation: Move to branding config from backend API

hardcoded_colors.recommendation: Move to CSS variables or theme context

hardcoded_colors.details: Default branding colors - ACCEPTABLE as fallback defaults

hardcoded_text.details: Default restaurant name in fallback branding

code_quality.recommendation: Remove or wrap in development-only conditionals

hardcoded_urls.issue: API_BASE_URL hardcoded instead of using env variable
hardcoded_urls.recommendation: Use React Native Config or similar for environment variables

hardcoded_colors.issue: Many inline hex colors instead of using colors theme

external_endpoints_called.native_app_calls_to_backend: Same as frontend - uses API_URL from /app/kiosk-native/KioskApp/src/utils/api.js

security_checklist.no_hardcoded_secrets: PASS - No API keys, passwords, or tokens found in source code
security_checklist.passwords_not_in_localStorage: PASS - Passwords NOT stored in localStorage. Only username stored for Remember Me. Legacy password storage cleaned up.
security_checklist.passwords_not_in_AsyncStorage: PASS - Native app does NOT store passwords. Only username for Remember Me.
security_checklist.auth_required_on_protected_endpoints: PASS - All menu/tables/orders endpoints return 401 without token
security_checklist.env_variables_used: PARTIAL - Backend uses .env correctly. Native app has hardcoded API_BASE_URL.
security_checklist.no_xss_vulnerabilities: PASS - No dangerouslySetInnerHTML or innerHTML usage found
security_checklist.no_sql_injection: N/A - MongoDB with Pydantic validation, no raw queries
security_checklist.error_messages_sanitized: PARTIAL - Login errors sanitized, but Pydantic validation errors expose structure

action_items: MEDIUM: Move hardcoded Hyatt logo URLs to branding config from backend API (10+ occurrences)
MEDIUM: Move hardcoded API_BASE_URL in native app to environment config
MEDIUM: Move hardcoded restaurant name 'Hyatt Centric' to branding config (3 occurrences)
MEDIUM: Tighten CORS configuration in production (currently allow_origins='*')
LOW: Move hardcoded colors in App.js toast config to theme variables
LOW: Move hardcoded colors in native TimingSettingsScreen.js to colors theme
LOW: Remove or conditionally log console.log statements in production
LOW: Sanitize Pydantic validation errors to not expose input structure
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY POSITIVE: Password storage properly handled - not in localStorage/AsyncStorage
SECURITY POSITIVE: Legacy password storage (kiosk_remember_pass) cleanup code present
SECURITY POSITIVE: Auth tokens required on all protected API endpoints
CODE QUALITY: Restaurant-specific branding should be dynamic, not hardcoded
CODE QUALITY: Native app API URL should use env config for different environments
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security audit complete. No critical vulnerabilities. Main issues are hardcoded restaurant-specific branding (logo URLs, restaurant names) that should be made dynamic. CORS is permissive but acceptable for kiosk apps. Auth bypass tests passed - all protected endpoints require valid token.
